text_block_list.text:
On our day off,
I came out shopping with Loves Only You,
but—

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
We'll be getting a whole bunch of new products
in soon.
Mainly training equipment, but...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Would you please consider filming a product
review video for us?
With your trusted opinion,
I know it would be a huge help to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'd be honored! If I can be of any help,
I'd love to.
Let's discuss the details over email ♪

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We're setting up a special corner for
beginners looking to get into fitness.
Would you mind recommending a few books to
feature?

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I've got my own picks,
but we'd really love to feature titles
curated
by an Umamusume with a broad perspective
like you, Loves Only You!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
it makes me so happy to hear you think of
me that way!
I'll pick out a few good ones and send them
your way.

Everywhere we went after that,
Loves Only You was approached
with requests to review items or give
recommendations.

Without a hint of reluctance,
she gladly accepted every single one without
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Having so many people reach out to me...
truly made today such a wonderful day.
choice_data_list: It just goes to show how much trus...
It just goes to show how much trus...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it that way makes me so
genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Being trusted enough to help someone
else...
If only everyone who receives that love
keeps passing it on to others.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, it's just so lovely.
Getting to be part of spreading that love
around.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I have to live up to their expectations.
Once the samples arrive,
I'll test them thoroughly,
and for the books—

Even with generous deadlines,
handling all of this alone would be
tough on Loves Only You. So—
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Thank you so much,
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Thank you so much,
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
let's test them out together!
It'll be way better than doing it all by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Even strapped directly onto the ankle,
it doesn't chafe against the skin,
which is nice.
It is pretty thick, though,
so it might make you sweat easily.
choice_data_list: Think it's suitable for everyday use?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As a weight it's not bad, but...
the design might be a little too plain?
Even if it's just for workouts,
if other people are going to see it,
style matters.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How about this book?
I think the explanatory sections are pretty
easy to understand.
choice_data_list: Yeah, but... maybe not for total b...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right? I'd love to recommend it,
but... let's keep it as an option
so they can read it once they've progressed
a bit—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We did it!
Thanks for your hard work, Trainer-kun ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We did it!
Thanks for your hard work, Trainer-chan ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All the data's been submitted safely...
Now we just wait for everything to hit the
shelves ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
everything went so smoothly.
Since I tend to see things strictly from an
Umamusume's point of view—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
everything went so smoothly.
Since I tend to see things strictly from an
Umamusume's point of view—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Having Trainer-kun catch the things I overlook
helps me discover brand-new perspectives.
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Having Trainer-chan catch the things I
overlook helps me discover brand-new
perspectives. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Helpful...?

As if sensing something unusual in my
words,
Loves Only You tilts her head slightly.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Umm, well... Ah! I see.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was just trying to figure out
how to put it into words,
and I got tongue-tied...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We spend so much time together, right?
Whenever there's a problem,
we consult each other and work on a solution
as one.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So this time too... before I knew it,
that's just how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What I mean is...
even though you've been supporting me,
I felt more like we were teammates striving
toward the same goal.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I guess you could say it feels just like
when we're training together for a race.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Not like you're standing behind supporting me,
but standing right beside me,
holding hands...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Maybe...
it's because I've always wished for that
kind of relationship with the Trainer who'd
take me on.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When we get lost,
when we hit a wall...
I want us to be partners who can reach out
and pull each other forward without
hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Yay, I'm so happy! Trainer-kun,
I want to share so many more things with
you from now on.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Yay, I'm so happy! Trainer-chan,
I want to share so many more things with
you from now on.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside me rather than behind me...
I'm sure I'll be able to convey so much more
to you that way.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside me rather than behind me...
I'm sure I'll be able to convey so much more
to you that way.

Loves Only You's words resonated with deep,
profound trust.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"I went ahead and bought that item you
introduced...
and it was amazing!
I'm already seeing huge results!"

text_block_list.name: Girl Who Gives Up Easily
text_block_list.text:
"Your reviews are as detailed and easy to
follow as ever...
It got me all motivated again!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I went to get that book you recommended
and snagged the very last copy! Barely made it,
but I wonder when the next restock is~"

Her followers are happily discussing the
items they bought.
Loves Only You truly lived up to the store's
trust.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When we get lost,
when we hit a wall...
I want us to be partners who can reach out
and pull each other forward without
hesitation!"

Remembering our conversation earlier today,
I ponder.
If I truly want to live up to her trust—
just doing this isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The shopkeeper was delighted,
and everyone who got their hands on the
items is all smiles...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's a huge success, Trainer-kun♡
choice_data_list: All the fans were thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's a huge success, Trainer-chan♡
choice_data_list: All the fans were thrilled too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I got quite a few comments about it too...
but hearing it from you, Trainer-kun,
makes everyone's words feel even closer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I got quite a few comments about it too...
but hearing it from you, Trainer-chan,
makes everyone's words feel even closer.

I return her beaming smile with one of my
own... Yet my heart remains unsatisfied.
Because as her Trainer—

Shouldn't there be something more—
like a "special kind of love" worthy of her
and her fans?

Still,
I have no idea how to put that into action.
As always,
I couldn't find an answer that truly satisfied
me.
